findings.text: Companies House records the company as active, and no insolvency record is held for it.
Accounts are not overdue; they were last made up to 28 February 2026 and the next accounts are due 26 August 2027.
The confirmation statement is not overdue; it was last made up to 18 June 2026 and the next is due 2 July 2027.
The register shows 2 outstanding, 0 part-satisfied and 7 satisfied charges, 9 in total.
There are 11 current officers, comprising 10 directors and 1 other officer.
No current person with significant control is on record, although this does not prove the company has no owner, as it may be exempt or have filed a PSC statement not covered by this check.

Across the 5 current directors checked, 83 other companies were found, of which 53 are active, 25 dissolved, 4 converted closed and 1 in liquidation; only the first 5 of 10 current directors were checked.
Since 24 October 2025, no registered office address changes were filed, and one officer resignation was recorded: PERSON 037 (director, 6 May 2026).
